summary: Frontend-only validation of new GTFS-RT 'veille automatique' (auto-detection) admin UI on /admin/transport. All 3 requested scenarios PASS: (1) gtfs-realtime-config panel renders by default with badge gtfs-realtime-status='Inactif (horaire théorique)', 3 empty URL inputs (rt-url-mq-centre/maritime/nord), rt-save-btn ('Enregistrer le temps réel') and rt-scan-btn ('Scanner maintenant') buttons visible. (2) Clicking rt-scan-btn triggers transportAPI.scanGtfsRealtime() — backend returns detected=[] (no real Martinique GTFS-RT feed published) → toast 'Aucun flux GTFS-RT publié pour le moment' shown, badge stays 'Inactif (horaire théorique)', gtfs-alert-bell and gtfs-alerts elements correctly remain absent (count=0). Button does not crash, no JS console errors triggered. (3) Régression OK: GTFS status block (Centre/CACEM, Maritime, Nord/Cap Nord cards) + 'Rafraîchir maintenant' button + tabs 'Arrêts (10)' & 'Lignes (4)' all render correctly. Final state left INACTIVE as required.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminTransport.js is now ~388 lines and the GTFS-RT block (config + alerts + scan + save) keeps growing — consider extracting a <GtfsRealtimeConfig/> sub-component to keep the page focused.

scanRt() error path uses a single generic toast 'Échec de la veille GTFS-RT' — surfacing the backend error (e.g. transport.data.gouv.fr unreachable, rate-limited) would help admins triage during incidents.

Toast for 'Aucun flux GTFS-RT publié pour le moment' uses toast.success() — semantically this is an info/neutral outcome (not a success); toast.info() or toast() would be slightly more appropriate. Cosmetic only.
seed_data_creation: None. Scanner did not detect any flux (expected), no alerts created, final state INACTIVE — system left clean as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GTFS-RT 'veille automatique' panel: data-testid='gtfs-realtime-config' on the wrapper, 'gtfs-realtime-status' on the badge ('Inactif (horaire théorique)' default), 'rt-url-mq-{centre|maritime|nord}' on URL inputs, 'rt-save-btn' (Enregistrer) and 'rt-scan-btn' (Scanner maintenant) on buttons. Alert UI is conditional: 'gtfs-alert-bell' (header bell) and 'gtfs-alerts' (alert block) + 'gtfs-alert-ack' (Marquer comme lu) ONLY render when backend reports unread alerts (gtfs?.unread_alerts && gtfs?.alerts?.length>0). Currently absent = correct. Scan endpoint: POST /api/transport/admin/gtfs/realtime/scan; ack: POST /api/transport/admin/gtfs/alerts/ack. Toast assertion via page.locator('body').inner_text() works (sonner toast text stays in DOM briefly).
